title: Locational Marginal Pricing of Compute: Co-optimizing Compute and Energy for Transparent Data Center Flexibility
abstract: arXiv:2611.20116v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Demand from data centers and AI compute is growing rapidly and is increasing stress on the power grid. This load could be flexible through user adjustments and provide relief during energy scarcity events, yet today its flexibility is provided through utility call-ups or system-operator load shedding, and is invisible to the users whose workloads are being curtailed. In this work, we propose to quantify and couple the prices of compute and energy in a single optimization problem. The resulting compute price reflects the marginal cost of the binding constraints and decomposes into components indicating which grid, power, hardware, or service requirement causes a price surge. The economic interpretation updates the price with real-time conditions and gives users a signal for potential flexibility provision. translated_title: 算力的节点边际定价：通过算力与能源的协同优化实现透明的数据中心灵活性
translated_abstract: 来自数据中心和AI算力的需求正在快速增长，并给电网带来越来越大的压力。这类负荷可以通过用户调整而具备灵活性，并在能源稀缺事件期间提供缓解，然而目前其灵活性是通过公用事业公司的调度指令或系统运营商的切负荷来实现的，且对于工作负载被削减的用户而言是完全不可见的。在本工作中，我们提出在单一优化问题中对算力和能源的价格进行量化并将二者耦合。所得到的算力价格反映了起约束作用的各类约束条件的边际成本，并可分解为若干组成部分，用以指示是电网、电力、硬件还是服务需求导致了价格飙升。这一经济学解释使价格能够随实时条件更新，并为用户提供了提供潜在灵活性的信号。这种协同优化最终将算力市场与能源市场连接起来，同时为缓解电网与算力系统的压力提供了信号。
tldr: 该论文提出在单一优化框架中对算力与能源进行节点边际定价的协同优化，使算力价格反映边际约束成本并可分解溯源至电网、电力、硬件或服务层面，从而连接算力与能源市场，为用户提供透明灵活性与缓解电网压力的实时价格信号。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a locational marginal pricing framework that co-optimizes compute and energy in a single problem, yielding a compute price that reflects marginal constraint costs and decomposes into interpretable grid, power, hardware, or service components, thereby connecting compute and energy markets while giving users a transparent real-time signal for flexibility provision and grid stress relief.
